name: P07 — WALL: hold a direction into a wall. Does the lens still run the wrong way?

steps.note: W1. the trace, on the real clock, six samples a frame-group

steps.eval: (async()=>{window.__T2=(btn,ms,every)=>new Promise(res=>{const S=[];const t0=performance.now();__DQ.hold(btn);let n=0;const tick=()=>{const c=__DQ.state().field.camera;const p=__DQ.state().player;if(n%every===0)S.push({t:+(performance.now()-t0).toFixed(0),lens:c.current,boom:c.boom,hold:c.hold,swing:c.swing,blocked:p.blocked?1:0,facingX:p.facing});n++;if(performance.now()-t0<ms)requestAnimationFrame(tick);else{__DQ.release(btn);res(S);}};requestAnimationFrame(tick);});return 'ready';})()

steps.note: W2. walk into open ground first so the camera is settled and facing straight ahead, THEN turn and drive at a wall
W3. now hold UP, which walks him into whatever is north of there, and watch the lens for 12 s
W4. THE TRUTH: seconds -> (lens, boom, swingRate, blocked). swingRate is the follow's own signed output; a lens that moves while swingRate is 0 is being moved by something else.
W5. REVERSALS. lensDelta = lens now minus lens a third of a second ago. A negative value means the lens is going the OTHER way to the request.
